metadata.description: NovÆxopia plugin marketplace: entries point at each plugin's own repository; no plugin code is stored here.

plugins.name: gangsta
plugins.description: AI agentic skills framework for spec-driven development — mafia-syndicate hierarchy with adversarial brainstorming, institutional memory, and governance guardrails

plugins.name: gas-gauge
plugins.description: A fuel gauge above the prompt: how much of your Claude plan is left, and when it refills.

plugins.name: iceberg
plugins.description: Apply Hemingway writing rules to technical documentation — inline, intentional, clean.

plugins.name: idle-compact
plugins.description: Compacts an idle interactive session shortly before its prompt cache expires, so coming back later doesn't re-read the whole context uncached.

plugins.name: idle-timing
plugins.description: Inject hidden timing context and visible idle gap notes into Claude Code prompts.

plugins.name: jev
plugins.description: Typed decisions as a noun: adds $.jev in the engine.create fold, so any plugin asks Jev a map of Choice, Score and Noul questions over one state and reads calibrated probabilities back — through the TypeSafe API, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, Cloudflare Workers AI, a LiteLLM proxy or any TypeSafe-compatible endpoint, set in the plugin's options or the environment.

plugins.name: jevmem
plugins.description: Say it once. jevmem saves the decisions, rules and failed approaches from your Claude Code chats to JEVMEM.md in your repo, brings the relevant ones back next session, and checks commands against your saved rules. Needs the jevmem CLI from npm and a TypeSafe API key. Opt-in per project.

plugins.name: learn-wiki
plugins.description: Learning-first development with a global, agent-maintained wiki of what you know.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Build a shared Markdown knowledge base with local hybrid search and an optional evidence-linked workflow to capture task lessons, evaluate skill improvements, and apply or roll back tested changes.

plugins.name: modern-web-guidance
plugins.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices

plugins.name: neocode
plugins.description: Matrix-style ambience for Claude Code: code decays into upward-streaming digital rain as it scrolls toward the top of the screen. Display-only: reads on-screen text and your selection in memory only, never changes the transcript, and uses no network, files or processes. Scrolling or selecting clears the rain until you pause; /neocode toggles it.

plugins.name: nvidia-skills
plugins.description: Find the right NVIDIA skill for GPU acceleration, CUDA, AI agents, data loading, training, inference, robotics, Physical AI, Omniverse, simulation, and other NVIDIA-powered workflows.

plugins.name: odometer
plugins.description: An odometer above the prompt: how long this session has run and what it has cost.

plugins.name: plugin-manager
plugins.description: Visual web UI for managing, toggling, and browsing Claude Code plugins. Opens as a standalone app window with Anthropic-styled interface.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Turn a rough prompt or coding task into a clear, ready-to-send prompt. Paste your draft, get one rewritten version. It never runs the task.

plugins.name: promptcolor
plugins.description: /promptcolor changes the background color of your own prompt lines in the Claude Code transcript so they are easy to spot while scrolling back.

plugins.name: reverse-engineering
plugins.description: Reverse engineering skill for Claude Code and other AI coding agents.

plugins.name: senior-engineering-partner
plugins.description: A strict code reviewer, pair programmer, debugger, and mentor for Python, Bash, Google Apps Script, and JavaScript — a security-first, phase-aware engineering discipline with an enforced spec → plan → TDD → verify workflow.

plugins.name: signal-hunter
plugins.description: AI-powered daily trend hunter. Aggregates 15+ sources (HN, GitHub, Reddit, YouTube, X/Twitter, newsletters, app stores), scores cross-source signals with newsletter mention tracking and velocity detection, generates Obsidian notes with business ideas and sends email digests.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create new skills, improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, update or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, or benchmark skill performance with variance analysis.

plugins.name: speedometer
plugins.description: A speedometer above the prompt: how full the context window is, from 0 to MAX.

plugins.name: supabase
plugins.description: Official Supabase plugin for Claude Code with bundled Supabase skills and MCP access for project management, database work, auth, storage, and Postgres best practices.

plugins.name: supabase-expert
plugins.description: Expert Supabase guidance for RLS policies, Auth flows, Storage setup, security auditing, and best practices. Helps build secure, performant Supabase applications.

plugins.name: turbocharge
plugins.description: Engineering team orchestration for Claude Code. 10 skills, 5 agents, 1 hook — single pipeline from brainstorm to shipped code.

plugins.name: wiki-wonka
plugins.description: A persistent LLM-maintained wiki for your knowledge base. Ingest sources, query your knowledge, and lint for consistency.

plugins.name: wizard
plugins.description: Build AI spells for what you do. A meta-framework for turning any repeatable task into a reusable workflow. Works for researchers, founders, students, writers, devs - anyone.
